blocks.title: Cybersecurity awareness
blocks.text: Cybersecurity awareness ka matlab online khatron se khud ko bachane ke tareeqe samajhna aur un par amal karna hai.

Kitab kehti hai ke cyber crime ki shikayat NR3C-FIA ko https://www.nr3c.gov.pk par ki ja sakti hai. Idare aur shikayat ke raaste badal sakte hain, is liye shikayat se pehle maujooda official raasta jaanch lein.

blocks.prompt: Agle hisse mein cybersecurity awareness ke do pehlu bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Khatre pehchanna (phishing, malware) aur zaati maloomat bachana (privacy settings, public posts mein ehtiyat).

items: Cybersecurity awareness: khatre jaanein, maloomat bachayein, cyber crime ki official shikayat karein.
